options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: golden
options.description: Golden query parameter. When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images marked as tagged golden. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images marked as not tagged golden.

options.name: hasAddonImages
options.description: HasAddonImages query parameter. When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images which have add-on images. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images which do not have add-on images.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: imported
options.description: Imported query parameter. When the value is set to `true`, it will include physically imported images. Conversely, when the value is set to `false`, it will include image records from the cloud. The identifier for cloud images can be utilized to download images from Cisco.com to the disk.

options.name: integrity
options.description: Integrity query parameter. Filter with verified images using Integrity Verification Available values UNKNOWN, VERIFIED.

options.name: isAddonImages
options.description: IsAddonImages query parameter. When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images that an add-on image. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images that are not add-on images.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. The minimum and maximum values are 1 and 500, respectively.

options.name: name
options.description: Name query parameter. Filter with software image or add-on name. Supports partial case-insensitive search. A minimum of 3 characters is required for the search.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1. The minimum value is 1.

options.name: productNameOrdinal
options.description: ProductNameOrdinal query parameter. The product name ordinal is a unique value for each network device product. The productNameOrdinal can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNames`.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Site identifier to get the list of all available products under the site. The default value is the global site. See https //developer.cisco.com/docs/dna-center/get-site for `siteId`.

options.name: supervisorProductNameOrdinal
options.description: SupervisorProductNameOrdinal query parameter. The supervisor engine module ordinal is a unique value for each supervisor module. The `supervisorProductNameOrdinal` can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNames`.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: version
options.description: Version query parameter. Filter with image version. Supports partial case-insensitive search. A minimum of 3 characters is required for the search.
